countersubjects.notes: CS1 modified at 7-10 to fit subject; CS2 added by tenor at 7; CS3 added by alto at 13, 'making this fugue unique among the 48'; CS3 last appears 27-30

subject.answer: tonal: subject has dominant as 1st and 3rd notes (like I.21) but, because of the chromatic downward step to the 4th note, only the 1st note is answered by the tonic

claims.claim: The tonal answer answers only the first note with the tonic (unlike I.21), because of the chromatic step to the fourth note
Soprano enters at 13 with subject instead of expected answer

The third countersubject never appears after bar 30
Episodes 1, 4, 6 are related (4 and 6 interchange/adorn 1); episodes 2, 3, 7 related (7 is a fuller version of 2)
